name: Small Request Intake and Review
description: A synthetic, reviewable workflow draft for receiving a small request, clarifying it, recording an exception, and preparing a handoff.
audience: A local owner or reviewer preparing a bounded work request.
inputs: Request summary, intended outcome, constraints, and any missing detail.
outputs: A clarified request, exception note when needed, and review handoff.
constraints: This is a draft, not a workflow engine. Keep all observations not-run until a person records evidence.
instructions: Capture the request, ask only for material missing detail, check scope, record an exception instead of silently expanding scope, prepare the draft, perform a review, and hand off the result with unresolved questions.

components.name: Request intake
components.purpose: Record the supplied request and stated outcome.

components.name: Exception path
components.purpose: Record a scope or evidence exception for review.

components.name: Draft preparation
components.purpose: Prepare the bounded result and open questions.

components.name: Review handoff
components.purpose: Deliver the draft with evidence status and next action.

tests.name: Missing input handling
tests.expected: The workflow asks for material missing detail without inventing it.

tests.name: Exception handling
tests.expected: An out-of-scope request is recorded for review rather than silently expanded.

tests.name: Reviewable handoff
tests.expected: The handoff states evidence status and unresolved questions.
